name: AECi — Data quality check found issues (by check)
message:
A §23.1 data-quality check found one or more issues in the daily run (AECI-241 / Phase 7.6). The alert is split `by {check}`, so the offending check (e.g. `products_without_vendor`, `broken_integration_refs`, `reviews_missing_anonymized_at`, `algolia_index_drift`) is named in the alert tags; the gauge value is the issue count for that check (the per-check gauge is emitted every run, 0 when clean — so this only fires on a real finding). A separate failed/crash monitor watches the sentinel -1 (a check that threw). This is **report-only** — the email digest to Chris + Bill carries the offending rows; triage and fix manually, and the next daily run re-checks.

Note: notify_no_data is OFF here — liveness is the companion 'AECi — Data quality job not running' monitor. The > 0 threshold is intentionally sensitive; per-check thresholds (e.g. tolerate N known duplicate candidates) are launch-tunable.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#data-quality-job-failed-or-not-running
